Pierce Benefield came from an Evangelical Christian family in Georgia, and got some good Bible basics from the Christian school he went to as a kid. As a young man, he became more serious about his faith, and began to explore Calvinism, and even briefly considered becoming a pastor.
During COVID, he was working at the Post Office, and a coworker invited him to a Reformed congregation that began to zero him in on his faith further. For the first time, he started exploring the differences between forms of Christianity, and was startled at how strong the intellectual case was for Catholicism. En 2013, la RCA s?est retrouv?e dans la tourmente lorsque des milices essentiellement musulmanes ont form? une coalition (S?l?ka) et ont pris le pouvoir dans le pays ? majorit? chr?tienne.
